proof.text: Use the epimorphism S.g from short exactness and exteriorSheafTensor_quotient_exists to obtain an epi q from the tensor with the exterior sheaf of lifts to the tensor with the exterior sheaf of the quotient, together with its formula on wedge sections. The comparison theorem conjugates the official quotient by the canonical exteriorSheafPowerIso tensor isomorphisms, preserving the wedge-section formula.

Conjugate q by the tensor comparison isomorphisms eAB and eAC to qprime = eAB.inv followed by q followed by eAC.hom. The comparison wedge formulas and tensorHom_app_tmulSection prove the official qprime formula. Apply the official determinant_liftWedge_kernel_exists to obtain wprime with its wedge formula and kernel annihilation. The map kernel.ι(q) followed by eAB.hom composes to zero with qprime, by cancellation of eAB.hom and eAB.inv and kernel.condition. Lift it through kernel(qprime) using kernel.lift. The equation kernel.lift_ι and annihilation for wprime show that kernel.ι(q) followed by eAB.hom followed by wprime is zero. Set w = eAB.hom followed by wprime followed by the inverse target comparison. Associativity proves annihilation for w, and the hom and inverse wedge formulas give its concatenated-wedge formula.

Set phi = Abelian.epiDesc q w hwzero. Mathlib comp_epiDesc gives q ≫ phi = w. Given tuples a,b,c with S.g(c_i)=b_i, replace b by the tuple of images, use the formula for q, evaluate q ≫ phi = w on the tensor of the a- and c-wedges, and apply the formula for w. This proves the unchanged displayed conclusion. The supplied family is not needed because descent constructs a global map independently.

statement: A chosen family of local wedge morphisms satisfying the prescribed formula glues to a global morphism satisfying that formula.

lean.statement: theorem determinant_wedgeMorphism_glue_family {X : Scheme.{v}} (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃) [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁] (φU : ∀ U : X.Opens, exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃ ⟶ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂) (hformula : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U)) (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)), (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op U) (c i) = b i) → (φU U).val.app (op U) (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a) (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ U b)) = exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ U (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))) : ∃ φ : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃ ⟶ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂, ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U)) (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)), (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op U) (c i) = b i) → φ.val.app (op U) (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a) (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ U b)) = exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ U (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))
